title: How to add a follow button to your website
description: The >x< Follow Button is a widget you can add to your website or homepage that lets visitors follow your account directly from that page. It's a simple way to increase your followers.

crumbs.title: How to add a follow button to your website

toc.title: How to add the follow button to your site

runs: The follow button allows people to follow your account directly from your personal homepage or any website where the button is installed. When people click this button, the following occurs:
a small pop-up screen displays with more information about your account when the button is clicked.
people will see a similar pop-up screen that allows them to view your account's following/follower information, sign in, and then follow you.

title: How to add the follow button to your site

runs: Customize the follow button to your liking with the available options.
Copy and paste the code into the HTML of your website wherever you would like the button to appear. (At this time, the follow button cannot be added to Facebook profiles.)
Your >x< profile already has a follow button to allow people follow you, but you will not see the option to follow your account when you view your own profile (because you can't follow yourself).
